:::{#thm-bernoulli-score-contribution}
#### Score contribution of one binary outcome

If $\Outvar_\iobs \sim \Ber(\prob)$ has observed value $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$
and precision $\precision = 1 / \Var{\Outvar_\iobs} = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$,
its score contribution is the precision times the deviation of $\outvar_\iobs$ from its mean $\prob$:

$$\score_\iobs(\prob) = \precision (\outvar_\iobs - \prob)$$

The precision $\precision$ is the same for every $\iobs$, because all $\Outvar_\iobs$ share the event probability $\prob$.

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-score-contribution, worked in @sol-bernoulli-score-contribution.

:::
